title: Rule of Five: an owning PointBuffer
hints: Copy ctor: allocate `new Point3[o.size_]` and std::copy. Move ctor: `data_(std::exchange(o.data_, nullptr)), size_(std::exchange(o.size_, 0))`.

Copy assignment via copy-and-swap: `PointBuffer tmp(o); swap(tmp); return *this;`. It's self-assignment safe and strongly exception-safe. To count it as ONE copy, put the deep-copy logic in a private helper constructor that doesn't touch the counter.
Move assignment: `if (this != &o) { delete[] data_; data_ = std::exchange(o.data_, nullptr); size_ = std::exchange(o.size_, 0); }`.
The vector-growth test fails unless BOTH move operations are marked `noexcept`.
